messages.subject: QX-Clock licensing to Caldera - can you act?
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to catch up yesterday. As discussed, we've reached the point with Caldera Defence where they want an exclusive licence of the QX-Clock family for their GNSS-denied navigation programme. Could Whitfield Carter act for us on the licence and the ancillaries? I'd like to move reasonably quickly - they're keen to sign before the end of Q1.

Best,
Eleanor

Dr Eleanor Frost | CEO | Arkwright Quantum Limited

Dear Eleanor,

Delighted to help. I've attached our engagement letter setting out scope, team and fee estimate (we'd run this to signing in the region of 75k-95k plus VAT). Elena Marchetti will support me. Please countersign and return when convenient and we'll get going on the NDA and a term sheet.

Kind regards,
Sarah
